name: UX Planet
summary: Medium publication collecting articles on UX design, user research and design careers.
description: UX Planet is a Medium publication that calls itself a one-stop resource for everything related to user experience. Articles sit under topics such as UX for beginners, user research and career, alongside UX, UX design, user experience design and product design; readers can submit a story, and the publication also runs a design-news newsletter.
